r2_d1_gru.label: Bidirectional GRU, 5-member ensemble on 3 banks (round 2, D1)

compute.notes: 5 members x 12 epochs on 86,400 trips (3 banks), RTX 3080 shared by up to 8 jobs: 14-20 min wall per member (1.39 GPU-h in all), process CPU 0.23-0.31 h per member (1.29 h). The v1.0 rungs r0-r2 (1.65 single-thread CPU-h) are the incumbent's.

r2_d1_gru.feature_engineering: as v1.0 trace_gru r1 (arms_trace/common/tracelib.py, unchanged): 5-s block means of the 1 Hz trace (12 channels), spec (49) and road load (5) standardised with train101 statistics, log distance / duration, physics anchor E_phys recomputed from the trace inputs (bake.e_phys_from_trace, declared), target log(y / E_phys), log(E_phys / A0) as an input. Ensemble: mean log-quantile per level over the 5 members, pred = exp(mean log q50) (round2/arms/common/enslib.py)

compute.notes: 5 members x (12 + 24) epochs on 86,400 trips (3 banks), RTX 3080 shared by up to 8 jobs: 63 min wall per member (5.21 GPU-h in all), process CPU ~1.0 h per member (4.88 h). The v1.0 rungs (1.64 single-thread CPU-h) are the incumbent's.

r2_d2_transformer.feature_engineering: as v1.0 trace_transformer r2 (arms_trace/common/tracelib.py, unchanged): 5-s block means of the 1 Hz trace (12 channels), 4-block (20-s) patch tokens, spec (49) and road load (5) standardised with train101 statistics, log distance / duration, physics anchor E_phys recomputed from the trace inputs (bake.e_phys_from_trace, declared), target log(y / E_phys), log(E_phys / A0) as an input. Ensemble: mean log-quantile per level over the 5 members, pred = exp(mean log q50) (round2/arms/common/enslib.py)

r2_x_cross.label: Cross-family ensemble: transformer + GRU + MLP + GP, equal weights (round 2, X)
r2_x_cross.family_label: Ensemble across learner families (equal-weight log-quantile average)

compute.notes: no training of its own; members: D2 4.88 CPU-h / 5.21 GPU-h, D1 1.29 / 1.39, v1.0 tab_mlp 0.62, v1.0 tab_gp 0.81 single-thread CPU-h

r2_x_cross.feature_engineering: none of its own. Members: r2_d2_transformer and r2_d1_gru on the trace batch; v1.0 tab_mlp and tab_gp on EnergyNet's 151 table inputs rebuilt from the trace batch by round2/arms/common/xlib.py (route vector, physics vector and E_phys from the trace and rl with EnergyNet's own feature code; the vehicle vector from spec with the label entries made relative again; checked against the table batch: median |log difference| of the members' predictions 1e-6 to 8e-5, arms/check_xinputs.json). Combination fixed in PREREG section 3: each level's log-quantile is the mean of the 4 members' (weights 1/4), pred = exp(mean log q50).

tab_gp.label: Sparse Gaussian process (SGPR, 500 inducing points)

compute.notes: torch (float64, one thread) for the bound optimisation and the posterior, time.process_time() inside train_gp.py; r1 includes a first attempt (M 1000, 20,000 rows per step) stopped by us at ~140 s because it used 1.4 GB; harness evaluations (<1 s prediction CPU each) not counted

tab_gp.feature_engineering: a scoped, standardised input set: the top-ranked of the 151 inputs by the GBM r0 mean model's gain on the simulated train bank (one-hot architecture / class columns skipped there; 32 in the released rung) + the 14 one-hot architecture / class columns; target z = log(y / E_phys); rows = the train bank under K = 3 tier draws

tab_mlp.label: MLP control (EnergyNet v2.1's network, retrained on the shared bank)
tab_mlp.family_label: Multilayer perceptron (ensemble of 5, correction to a physics estimate)

compute.notes: torch 2.15 CPU, one thread, time.process_time() inside train_mlp.py; r1 reuses r0's seed-0 network (471 s = all 5 members); harness evaluations (~8 s prediction CPU each) not counted

tab_mlp.feature_engineering: none: the 151 EnergyNet inputs, standardised as EnergyNet does (mean / sd from one tier draw, clipped at +-8); target log(y / E_phys) + the 5 log component shares (EnergyNet's auxiliary head)

trace_gru.label: Bidirectional GRU on the trip trace

compute.notes: r0 0.58, r1 0.54, r2 0.51 (rejected); + 0.02 for a speed benchmark and a 2-min first launch killed for memory; one thread, shared 2-core machine

trace_gru.feature_engineering: trace-track inputs only: the harness's shared 5-s block means (bake.block_means rule: 8 channel means + mean v^2, mean v^3, summed positive kinetic-energy increment per unit mass) + the block's valid-second fraction -> 12 scaled channels; spec (49) and rl (5, logs of mass / CdA / Crr) standardised with train-bank statistics; log distance and log duration from the trace; chunks of <= 1,440 blocks mean-pooled for longer traces; anchor r0 = sim-train median MJ/km per (architecture, class) (bake.dumb_rates) x distance; from r1: E_phys recomputed from the trace inputs by bake.e_phys_from_trace (EnergyNet's generic road-load estimate; declared), target log(y / E_phys), log(E_phys / A0) as an input

trace_transformer.label: Transformer on the trip trace (20-s patch tokens)

compute.notes: r0 0.19, r1 0.17, r2 0.33, r3 0.90 (rejected); + 0.05 for a 1-epoch smoke run (0.015), a speed benchmark, a 2-min first launch killed for memory and r3 steps lost to a container restart; one thread, shared 2-core machine

trace_transformer.feature_engineering: trace-track inputs only: the harness's shared 5-s block means (bake.block_means rule: 8 channel means + mean v^2, mean v^3, summed positive kinetic-energy increment per unit mass) + the block's valid-second fraction -> 12 scaled channels; spec (49) and rl (5, logs of mass / CdA / Crr) standardised with train-bank statistics; log distance and log duration from the trace; chunks of <= 1,440 blocks mean-pooled for longer traces; anchor r0 = sim-train median MJ/km per (architecture, class) (bake.dumb_rates) x distance; from r1: E_phys recomputed from the trace inputs by bake.e_phys_from_trace (EnergyNet's generic road-load estimate; declared), target log(y / E_phys), log(E_phys / A0) as an input
